learn.chapter_title: MINDFUL EATING A PATH TO A HEALTHY BODY
learn.text:
What Do We Eat?

Everyone eats food every day, and it is an essential part of daily life. Food should be wholesome, consumed in moderate quantities, and appropriate for the season, time, and place.

learn.chapter_title: MINDFUL EATING A PATH TO A HEALTHY BODY
learn.text:
Food in Different Regions

Different parts of India have different traditional foods and crops grown locally. For example, Punjab traditionally eats Makki di roti, sarson da ghat, and pulses, while Karnataka eats Idli, dosa, and coconut chutney.

                                               हितभुक् मितभुक् ऋतुभुक्
                                                                                  (सभु ाषित)
                           Who is healthy? Who is healthy? Who is healthy? One
                          who eats food that is wholesome, in moderate quantities,
                             and appropriate for the season, time, and place.
                                                                                (Wise saying)
